readings.speaker: sp-henderson
readings.name: Arthur Henderson
readings.text: Verified casualties up to the evening of 16th March were 1,046 killed and 1,167 injured.
readings.credit: Read by a computer voice. No recording of Arthur Henderson was used.

readings.speaker: sp-baldev-singh
readings.name: Baldev Singh
readings.text: We have closed a dreary chapter. [...] It would be untrue if I say we are altogether happy. [...] It does not please everybody, not the Sikh community, anyway. But it is certainly worth while. Let us take it.
readings.credit: Read by a computer voice. No recording of Baldev Singh was used.

readings.speaker: sp-butler
readings.name: R. A. Butler
readings.text: As Punjabi-born, and knowing most of the districts intimately, with other members of my family and friends, I feel myself quite heartbroken at this decision.
readings.credit: Read by a computer voice. No recording of R. A. Butler was used.

readings.speaker: sp-jinnah
readings.name: Muhammad Ali Jinnah
readings.text: You are free; you are free to go to your temples, you are free to go to your mosques or to any other places of worship in this State of Pakistan.
readings.credit: Read by a computer voice. No recording of Muhammad Ali Jinnah was used.

readings.speaker: sp-noel-baker
readings.name: Philip Noel-Baker
readings.text: some 2,000 armed raiders entered Kashmir, on or about the 22nd October; they took the Jhelum Valley road leading to Srinagar
readings.credit: Read by a computer voice. No recording of Philip Noel-Baker was used.

readings.speaker: sp-fatima-jinnah
readings.name: Fatima Jinnah
readings.text: In that hour of trial the women of Pakistan played their part and contributed their full share by working day and night for the relief of the sick and the wounded.
readings.credit: Read by a computer voice. No recording of Fatima Jinnah was used.

readings.speaker: sp-aizaz-rasul
readings.name: Begum Aizaz Rasul
readings.text: I will go into the history of the events of the last two years. It is a very sad history and no one can deny that the Muslims living in this country have been the greatest sufferers as a result of the events that have taken place. Not only have their lives and property been in danger and full of insecurity, but their very honour has been at stake and their loyalties have been questioned. This caused great sense of frustration and mental depression.
readings.credit: Read by a computer voice. No recording of Begum Aizaz Rasul was used.
